about_the_game:
Battle your way through randomized world maps with your personal army in 9-Bit Armies: Going Rogue!

Earn, upgrade, and repair units and structures to take from battle to battle in this Roguelite Real-Time Strategy game. Collect artifacts to power up, and consumables to give you a tactical edge when you need it the most.

Defeat the final boss and receive a persistent veteran unit to fight by your side in future runs.

An internal gameplay experiment by some rogue Petroglyph team members, Going Rogue! is a whole new way to play 9-Bit Armies that was too fun to keep to ourselves.
